incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — usage-wave-overhang (sev2) — billing count divergence detected across regional emitters. Alert: ~12% token delta vs expected window. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/1753141592

erin (SRE): taking. joining call in 2.

jordan (oncall): oncall here, handoff logged. any customer-visible overage flags?

alice (Billing): seeing delayed usage reports in the pipeline, some overage emails were queued and retried. looks like a 30–60m emit lag for EU region.

miguel (Ingest): kafka consumer lag on consumer-group ingest-eu-7 is spiking, offsets stuck at ~+450k. possible shard GC on collector. investigating.

erin (SRE): do we have a snapshot of emitted token counts by customer for last hour? need to triage false positives.

alice (Billing): pulling CSV now. early sample: 8 customers show +80% delta flagged; most are low-volume. could be duplication on replay.

jordan (oncall): meanwhile can we mute human-facing overage emails? want to avoid spamming customers.

alice (Billing): yes, muting outbound overage notifier for EU queue for now. toggled in console -> billing -> notifications :white_check_mark:

samir (CS): heads-up — two customers already pinged support. telling them we're on it.

miguel (Ingest): reproducing consumer offset stall locally. consumer stuck in `handleBatch()` on a compaction path. quick hotfix: bump max.poll.records and restart replicas. planning restart of 2 pods on ingest-eu-7.

miguel (Ingest): command I'll run:```bash
kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingest-eu-7 -n prod --patch "{\"spec\":{\"template\":{\"metadata\":{\"annotations\":{\"restartedAt\":\"$(date -u +%s)\"}}}}}"```

erin (SRE): good. before restart, snapshot offsets and submit to incident artifacts.

miguel (Ingest): offsets snapshot uploaded: https://s3.redwood/incidents/1753141592/offsets-eu-7.log

jordan (oncall): restarting now (rolling, 30s between pods).

# short pause ~4m

miguel (Ingest): restarts completed, consumer lag falling back to normal within 90s. tail shows no duplicate commit errors.

alice (Billing): reprocessing window drain started. counts reconciling, duplicate emission removed by dedupe step. current delta down to ~1.2%.

erin (SRE): keeping alerts muted until recon soak completes (30m). set a rollback if deltas reappear.

samir (CS): updated customers on support threads that we found root cause (ingest consumer stall) and that billing may have produced transient overage flags; refunds/credit path prepared.

jordan (oncall): postmortem checklist: collect logs, offset snapshots, billing queue snapshot, and timeline. assign owners: miguel for root cause, alice for billing reconciliation, erin for postmortem doc.

alice (Billing): making reconciliation ticket and refund list now.

miguel (Ingest): will open RCA with timeline and patch to avoid GC stalls (increase heap target and add backpressure).

erin (SRE): closing pager, monitoring for 30m. thanks team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident updated: status -> mitigated; runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/1753141592; severity lowered to sev3.
